title: Covariant Baer-group functor of degree-one Yoneda extensions
statement: Let $\mathcal B$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], with objects in universe $u$ and morphisms in universe $v$. Use derived $\operatorname{Ext}$ in universe $\max(u,v)$, and fix its endpoint-natural normalized comparison $c$ with the Baer groups of actual Yoneda classes [def-pur-yoneda-derived-ext-comparison-data]. For $C,M\in\mathcal B$, let $Y_c(C,M)$ be the existing quotient of short exact sequences $0\to M\to B\to C\to0$ by endpoint-fixed equivalence [def-coef-yoneda-extension-data], with the Baer group of $c$. Define the covariant functor $Y_c(C,-):\mathcal B\to\mathbf{Ab}$ as follows: on objects it is $Y_c(C,M)$; on $f:M\to N$ it sends $e$ to $c_{N,C}^{-1}(\operatorname{Ext}^1(C,f)(c_{M,C}(e)))$. Endpoint naturality of $c$ identifies this map with pushout of extensions along $f$. It is additive, sends identities to identities, and sends composites to composites. Its canonical filtered-colimit comparison is the map induced by pushout along the colimit cocone.
